name: Kisaragi Koi
source: Koi is a naturally friendly, amiable type of person. He is good at socializing, making him a person with lots of friends from either gender, and always encourages those who feel down. He is also described to be earnest, hard-working, straightforward, and quite well-informed. Because of this, he's made some startling connections. As a result of his naturally extroverted personally, Koi gets along very well with their staff members.
